## 2. Complete tensor tails and finite rank compiler

Use tested C=.00347611041, uniform C0=.00347611040, t=1-C,
u=1/5,v=1024. Complete every product target below18^1024 by a paid
complementary operation **on the same owner**, and split all old and
new paid operations at17^1024. This creates no independent DATA credit.
The retained charged upper bound is

    alpha^v + 2 gamma^v + 2 delta^v,
    alpha=P_t/T_t,
    gamma=P_(t+u)/(17^u*T_t),
    delta=11400*18/(17^C*T_t).

The two separate rational engines certify

    alpha < .999999999990333712977496242157 < 1-2^-39,
    gamma < .958138718122069468445491070072 < 31/32,
    delta < .948389584343131930157108110905 < 19/20.

Both (31/32)^128 and (19/20)^128 are below1/16. Thus each corresponding
1024th power is below2^-32. Since

    1 - 1/(1+1024*2^-39) - 4*2^-32
      = 536870911/576460753377165312 > 0,

all original and completion tails fit. After these explicitly paid
operations the exit/child separation follows from17^64<18^63, not from
the false base assertion63<4. The raw127-dimensional ambient is below256.

Put z=1-C0,z0=(t+z)/2,h=1/64 and d=z0-t. Exact rational ceilings give

    H0=377296594739200,

    H0*h*d >= d*(5+8*h)*1024 + 1+8*1024*(1-z0),

These are effective **rank-compiler** thresholds. They are not claims
about old tape, semantic precision or running-time thresholds. The old

Here is an explicit, intentionally oversized finite bound in retained
primitive invocations. Its role is to make dependence on the *new* finite
program concrete. It is not an assertion that every retained primitive's
machine-time constant equals one.

Adding base scans/parking/routes/raw descriptors and the crude
57321*(32*127^2+8*127^3) dimension-work allowance gives971523007765<2^64.
Let K=2^(256*1024). K bounds all integer ranks, role/round/operation
inventories after chronological tensoring, target completion and paid
splitting: the pre-tensor inventory is below2^64, tensor descriptions are
bounded by products of fixed inventories, and even splitting every rank
into ones is dominated by this K. The latter is an upper bound only;

For the integer compiler at rank n<=N use

    J(n)=(n+1)^4*K^(4*n+4),
    A(1)=K^4,
    A(n)=(J(n)+2)^4*(A(n-1)+2)^(4*n+8).

Class depth is at most log2(n)<=n. Paid-round sequences and weighted target
multi-indices contribute at most K^n each; source/exit/rank accounting is
bounded by J(n). Every smaller width is at most A(n-1). A denominator
clearer equal to the product of required smaller widths is at most
A(n-1)^(n-1). J and the displayed A recurrence dominate replication,
smaller-program inlining, scalar and route descriptions, and allocating
two owned banks for each compiled unit. In particular productive B_N,
leaf P_N and compiled instances are <=A(N); reserve C_N<=2*A(N) owned
banks, even if a unit is suspended. None of C_N enters B_N.

The checker reconstructs644 nonzero base frame projectors, all fixed new

An exact rational operation increases numerator/denominator bit height by

Compile the entire finite matrix/denominator/rank-witness list first.

Choose one odd prime q>max(2^45*N^5,2^(2*H)), avoiding that finite list.

Each high-row route uses polynomially many fixed affine/scaling/ordered

For example high-row right multiplication takes N independent N-field

One conservative total multiplier for the completed finite program is

## 4. Whole cover, arbitrary rows and stock

Let d_cover=2^-36+10^-20 and C1=C0-d_cover. Exactly

    C1=22781037022072568293839/6553600000000000000000000.

Since2^45*d_cover>256, the delayed whole-GL cover's full bad-class
surcharge is below1+d_cover/4, whereas N^d_cover>=1+d_cover/2. This
preserves strict contraction at covered saving C1, after the finite
program is compiled. All current jobs remain actual whole arrays;
canonical matcher right routes are paid before/after the complete unit.
Only final rank1 leaves are lowered. One external ancestor-only weight
is common through each compiled invocation; incompatible child-specific
weights are not silently combined.

The uniform unit operates at every column count f and preserves complete
spectators, arbitrary current RAW correlations and ordered paired tails.
An owned SUM can serve as a child argument but earns no new parent input
credit. Every unit instance has distinct owned tags. The whole source
endpoint is unchanged by replacing the G20 window; neither FRAME
retagging nor an unproved read-only SOURCE premise is used.

A safe borrowed stock is W(w)^D*S_backend, where

    W(w)=B_N*|GL_N(F_q)|*q^(N^2*(w-1)),
    D=floor(log_N ceil(e/w))+1.

Its borrowed digits are bounded by

    D*[N^2*(w-1)+ceil(log_q(B_N*|GL_N(F_q)|))]
      +ceil(log_q S_backend)+1 = O_new(w loge).

The inner completed backend keeps the entire outer row/spectators fixed,
borrows from its own complete argument, and restores that stock before
return. No external empty space or fresh DATA appears. Padding/unpadding
occurs at completed endpoints with a fixed volume factor; the backend's
prime need not equal q. The ordinary two-body wrapper and high-part
exchange are the retained completed contract, with their positive fees.

## 5. Three fixed levels and eventual thresholds

Use rho=1/100 and w=ceil(e^rho), starting from the completed ordinary
PR4814 A0 with b0=1737729/500000000. Freeze a *distinct* A_j after A_(j-1)
has been completed. Coarse calls decrease atom count; backend calls
decrease the finite level j. There is no self/forward reference or a
bootstrap depth tending to infinity with e.

The three charged root terms are

    O_new(V*[e^(1-rho)
      + e^((1-rho)*(1-C1)+rho*(1-b_(j-1)))
      + e^rho*loge]).

Put a_j=(1-rho)C1+rho*b_(j-1) and relax on the1e-12 grid. Exact checks give

    b1=.003476103861,
    b2=.003476110320,
    b3=.003476110384.

Every step satisfies b_(j-1)<b_j<a_j<C1<rho<1-a_j. All three margin lists
are saved as exact fractions. Each stage has new fixed machine constants
and eventual threshold; none of PR4814's old numeric thresholds is reused.

For clarity a sufficient eventual-threshold schema is explicit. Let K_j
be at least16 times the positive finite F multiplier, all retained
primitive constants, reserve/adapter constants and the already completed
backend bound globalized to all widths by its finite fallback. Let

    eta_j=min(rho-a_j,1-rho-a_j,a_j-b_j)>0.

A new integer threshold can dominate the previous backend threshold to
power ceil(2/rho), the borrow threshold, and

    ceil((32*K_j/eta_j)^(ceil(8/eta_j)))+2^(ceil(8/eta_j)).

The elementary bound loge<=2/eta_j*e^(eta_j/2) shows these oversized
choices absorb every finite coefficient in the three root costs and
force borrowed digits<e/2. Backend calls below their own threshold use
their completed all-width fallback. Smaller outer widths use A_(j-1).
Only three such constructions occur. Numerical decimal expansions of
these fixed machine constants or the enormous final WORD are not claimed.

## 6. Cold certificate and limits

The isolated CLI verifies input hashes, the sealed native manifest and
all its runtime byte pins; it does not import a producer's auditor as the
arithmetic proof. A separate reader recounts actual stream P/target T,
and a different rational positive-series engine rederives all three tails,
H0/H1, prime allowance, C1 and every finite backend separator. Negative
controls reject unfunded alpha slack, an insufficient prime, old H0 and
raw-root-as-ordinary overclaim. All scientific outputs match normal/-O.

This certifies the explicitly conditional ordinary saving above, not an
unconditional native machine theorem, materialized uniform DAG, new
record, or whole-kappa improvement. Root independent review remains
required before treating it as a future-bundle input.
